dedupe_keys.name: tide gauge data from townsville port 1993

description: Tide Gauge data from Townsville Port - 1993 is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This is data collected during dredging by the Townsville Port Authority in Cleveland Bay in 1993. Data are divided into a number of main groups: Wind, tide gauge, wave rider, S4, sediment traps, water samples and nephelometers. Unique site numbers were assigned within Cleveland Bay at which data were collected. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Oceans | Tides | Tidal Height, Tide Gauges, depth. It offers 8 resource(s) in html, png, txt, wms. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
